From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: People Ops <hr@peopleops.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 people risk triage + manager action items

Team —

I want to kick off a short triage based on the Q2 engagement snapshot we got this morning (attached). Two quick framing points:

- This thread is confined to leadership + People Ops for confidentiality.
- The goal: surface the top risks, assign manager follow-ups, and agree a communication cadence to HR.

Highlights from the summary (high level):
- Engagement dip concentrated in two engineering pods; themes: unclear career paths and manager bandwidth.
- We have 2 ICs flagged by pulse + one voluntary exit signal from a senior IC in a revenue-adjacent team (outreach ongoing with their manager).
- Managers asked for tooling/templates for structured 1:1 follow-ups — copying People Ops.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Managers to run focused 1:1s this week using the attached manager_action_template.xlsx (deliverable: short notes + commitment list).
2) Leadership calibration call on Thursday 10:30am PT to review outcomes and decide on retention gestures or role adjustments.
3) People Ops to prepare confidential checklist for escalations and recruiting priorities.

Please reply with who will own the 1:1s for the at-risk pods, and whether Thursday works for the calibration call. I’ll consolidate and send the invite.

Attachments: engagement_summary_q2.pdf, manager_action_template.xlsx

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
VP, People & Talent
Redwood Inference
